Paper00-EvidenceIntegrityBatch4-v1_1

18 November 2026 | Three additional direct source-evidence repairs, without fabricating numerical witness arrays.

What was corrected

  1. VII-D / BH-VIID-G-0002 (864×864 exact inertia and gap): The manuscript previously asserted all sixteen exact dyadic witnesses, a checker and rational result files were supplied in Audit/. The seven explicitly named inertia/chiral program filenames were searched across the four user-provided framework archives; the named inertia witness and exact checkers were not present. The theorem is now explicitly conditional on the exact rational Gram and congruence checks and a replayable pair of integer witness matrices for each phase. The inertia (433,431), strict gap and clock-cover index are retained as conditional mathematical consequences, not independently confirmed values.
  2. VII-D / BH-VIID-G-0003 (four chiral comparison checkers): The four named programs are not present in those releases. Historical numerical claims remain recorded as claims; no actual executable data or physical condensate is certified.
  3. VII-D / BH-VIID-G-0005 (face-incidence eigenvalues): The 2/3, 1/3, 1/6 spectrum now requires an exact normalized incidence operator and eigenprojections. On that hypothesis the squared factors 16:4:1 follow by elementary finite spectral algebra. The current releases do not contain the required exact matrix/eigenspace certificate, nor do these geometric factors establish glueball poles.

The correction retains the proposed results and precise observable questions. It does not erase content, but removes mathematically unsupported claims that finite witness files were already supplied or independently verified.

Evidence scope and remaining owner

The missing named files are absent by exact archive-entry filename search in PapersMinimal v3.033, DAGAtlas v1.183, ProofChainAudits v1.75, and S3StructureNetwork v1.36. This does not establish that another archive or historic repository could not contain them. The 864-dimensional theorem can be independently promoted only after the matrix constructor, sixteen integer witness arrays, checker code, and its rational result files are actually available and replayed. The same rule applies to the four chiral checkers and the incidence eigenspace calculation.

VII-D now compiles without undefined references under Macros-v2_186. Papers III-F and V-C remain mathematically unchanged from the prior source release; their historical macro imports remain available to reproduce their published PDFs.

Current issue accounting

250 known issue IDs retained: 73 unadjudicated, 33 source-repaired requiring stronger re-verification, 3 evidence-guarded issues with missing finite inputs, and all other status classes from v1.5 unchanged. No new physical observable was claimed. Full details: Paper00-ClosedGapCrosswalk-v1_6.json and Paper00-RemainingProofObligations-v1_2.json.
